scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run --workspace=frontend install && npm run --workspace=backend install
scripts.dev: npm run --workspace=frontend dev & npm run --workspace=backend dev
scripts.build: npm run --workspace=frontend build & npm run --workspace=backend build
scripts.test: npm run --workspace=frontend test & npm run --workspace=backend test
scripts.lint: npm run --workspace=frontend lint & npm run --workspace=backend lint
